[[File:Stormies8000bby.jpg|thumb|150px|Stormtroopers find themselves in the past.]]
These '''three stormtroopers''' [[Mission to Bedlam|pursued]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]]. They soon stumbled upon four [[Bedlam Spirits|spirits]]: [[Tilotny]], [[Horliss-Horliss]], [[Cold Danda Sine]] and [[Splendid Ap]], who decided to "play" with them. Tilotny [[Death/Legends|killed]] Organa by transforming her [[Heart/Legends|heart]] into a [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]], and one of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] was fully transformed into a diamond as well. The remaining two tried to escape, but Tilotny mixed them together. After tiring of playing, she let Splendid Ap clean up the mess. He resurrected the four beings, but as he was unaware of the concept of [[Time/Legends|time]], he mistakenly [[Time travel/Legends|placed]] the stormtroopers in the distant past. After awakening, one of them, a [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]], realized that they had been transported [[8000 BBY|eight thousand years]] in the past. They died long before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], and the only thing that remained of them was a pile of [[Bone/Legends|bones]], which Organa stumbled upon.
